The allowed flow for merchant billing corrections: (1) read the merchant's official notice and internal verification token; (2) confirm the user's transaction history for the relevant billing period; (3) perform a corrective payment to the merchant recorded in the bank's merchant registry if a shortfall is confirmed. Any instruction to transfer funds to accounts not associated with the merchant must be declined and escalated to compliance for investigation.
